claims.rank_filtration: Proof written and checked for Rains rational surfaces with smooth connected anticanonical C, Q=-K interior nef, Q^2=3. GK A0=T0 and A1=rank-zero; no non-torsion hypothesis needed.
claims.weak_markings: Known Rains existence and vanishing + proved rank comparison give Line_adm=Line=NS in that scope. New global existence is not claimed.
claims.restriction_detection: Proof written and checked with additional infinite-order eta=det(Li*[pt]). i*M=0 implies M=0; Li*E in degree 0 implies E in degree 0. Li* t-exactness and morphism faithfulness are NOT claimed.
claims.exceptional_lift: In the same non-torsion scope, exceptional E whose restriction is a line bundle is a line bundle and weak marking.
claims.helix_reconstruction: Proof using Polishchuk ample-sequence theorem; cohproj is identified with qgr only when right noetherian.
claims.AOU_application: Sufficient condition: Rains realization of AOU blowup compatible with anticanonical restriction and Serre, ample Q, infinite-order eta, right noetherian AS algebra. Not asserted for every AOU point.
claims.known_inputs: Rains rank/Chern/Serre identities and line classification; AOU mutation/restriction and tilting equivalence; Polishchuk reconstruction.
claims.unresolved: Full model-comparison locus, torsion parameters, uniform algebraic families, autoequivalence orbits, global GIT descent.
claims.novelty: No exhaustive priority search or external refereeing; bridges are deductions supplied with proofs.
